execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT
  m.chembl_id,
  m.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  m.max_phase,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  dm.action_type,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM molecule_dictionary m
JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON m.molregno = dm.molregno
JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid
JOIN compound_structures cs ON m.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE m.max_phase = 4
  AND dm.action_type = 'AGONIST'
ORDER BY
  m.chembl_id,
  m.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  m.max_phase,
  dm.mechanism_of_action,
  dm.action_type,
  td.chembl_id,
  td.pref_name
```
